facts.fact: 老板娘连开第二、第三把伞，每把伞里各藏一个女鬼。
facts.anchor: Madam Yau opened the second umbrella. Then the third. Each housed another ghost.

facts.fact: Kiamling 从藏身处跳出，手持铜钱剑向女鬼掷符。
facts.anchor: She leapt forward from her hiding position, coin sword in hand, flinging fu talismans towards the malevolent spirits

facts.fact: 老板娘徒手攥住剑尖，拦下了这一记杀招。
facts.anchor: Madam Yau’s fist closed over the tip of the sword, stopping the killing blow.

facts.fact: 老板娘叫她“小妹妹”，说她这一行干得差。
facts.anchor: “You are bad at this, mui mui.”

facts.fact: Kiamling 认出对方是狐精 wulei jing。
facts.anchor: “A wulei jing.” Kiamling recalled the fox spirit

facts.fact: 老板娘说曾答应她祖母，要护住这些女鬼。
facts.anchor: “The only thing is… I made a promise to your grandmother that I would protect them.”

facts.fact: 老板娘说这一切是她祖母 Por Por 安排的。
facts.anchor: “Your Por Por organised this arrangement.”

facts.fact: 她收剑，要对方把事情说清楚。
facts.anchor: She sheathed her sword. “I think you’d better fill me in.”

facts.fact: 老板娘先要求喂她那群饿极了的女孩。
facts.anchor: “Can I feed my girls first? They are ravenous.”

facts.fact: 楼下舞台已空，Jingling 演完不见踪影。
facts.anchor: The stage, however, was empty, with no sign of Jingling after her performance.

facts.fact: 老板娘领她上楼，进了一间私室。
facts.anchor: Upstairs, Madam Yau led her into a private chamber.

facts.fact: 一个衣着富态的华商把手粗暴地探进妓女的裙里。
facts.anchor: A wealthy Chinese merchant by the looks of his clothes. He thrust a hand rudely up the courtesan’s skirt

facts.fact: 老板娘低声叫她开第三眼。
facts.anchor: “Open your third eye,” Madam Yau whispered.

facts.fact: 女鬼吸走男人的气，眼窝饱满起来、头发变得油亮。
facts.anchor: The hollows under her eyes filled out, her black hair lustrous as she gathered in the man’s qi.

facts.fact: 男人躺在自己弄出的污糟里，遍体伤痕。
facts.anchor: He lay bruised and battered in a sticky mess of his own creation.

facts.fact: 女鬼饮足了他的气，但他还活着。
facts.anchor: She had quenched her thirst on his qi, but he still lived.

facts.fact: 楼上由女鬼承接床笫之役。
facts.anchor: Upstairs, the lui gwei provide the services of the bedchamber.

facts.fact: Kiamling 指出这仍在缩短人的寿命。
facts.anchor: “You are still shortening lives.”

facts.fact: 老板娘问：女人何时有过不当猎物的机会。
facts.anchor: When do women ever get the chance to be anything other than prey?

facts.fact: 针口之由：男人不想看见女人的牙。
facts.anchor: “Why do you think hungry ghosts have needle mouths? Because men do not want to see our teeth.”
